Assignment Title: Extending Interfaces - Smart Home Device Control

Assignment Question:
Design an interface BasicDevice with method turnOn(). Design an extended interface SmartDevice that inherits BasicDevice and adds method setSchedule(int hours). Implement SmartDevice in class SmartThermostat.
 
Accept hours parameter. If hours is between 1 and 24 (inclusive), turn the device on and set its schedule. Otherwise, print Invalid Input.
 
Input Format:
Line 1: Hours as an integer.
 
Output Format:
Line 1: Device Turned On
Line 2: Schedule Set for <hours> hours
Or Invalid Input for non-numeric or out-of-bound hours.
